- `file` is created at line 13 using `name` (which depends on `root`)
- At line 25, `FileUtils.copy(in, file)` uses this `file`

Since `file` is constructed using `name`, and `name` depends on `root` (through `getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName())`), the value of `file` at line 25 does depend on the value of `root` at line 3.
